Name: Talkohlooey's Artstyle Portrait - Ridgeside Village
Author: DreamWoIf
Description:
This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]Scale Up Unofficial.

[/url]It includes [b]157 unique portraits[/b] to bring your villagers to life!
Just unzip the folder, drop it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory, and when your computer asks if you want to replace files, hit [b]Replace[/b]—and you're all set!
[b]Make sure that they get replaced; otherwise, the mod will not work![/b]

Downloads.Description: unzip and place into mod file and replace 157 files

Manifest.Name: (CP)1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Ridgeside Village
Manifest.Description: Portraits for all NPCs in RSV in Talkohlooeys' style
